note: A2 grammar is a tool for communicative tasks. Teach one main pattern at a time, retrieve it after a delay, and reuse it in a changed situation. A1 grammar remains in review.

points.title: Connect clauses and organize a short answer: et, mais, parce que, donc, d'abord, ensuite, enfin
Passé composé with avoir and regular -er past participles
Common irregular past forms with avoir and a starter set of common verbs with être
Imparfait for past habits, descriptions and background
Choose passé composé for completed events and imparfait for background or habit
Futur proche review and common futur simple forms for plans and predictions
Comparatives and superlatives for familiar choices
Relative pronouns qui, que and où to combine familiar details
Direct object pronouns le, la and les before the verb
Indirect object pronouns lui and leur with common verbs
Y for a previously named place with common aller/être patterns
En for quantities with common partitive and quantity patterns
Affirmative and negative imperative for simple instructions
Polite conditional requests with pouvoir and vouloir; build on je voudrais
